decisions.reason: It fits the firm’s natural facial-care focus and its continued dedicated product page in 2023 and 2024 suggests solid demand and strategic importance.
The serum stays close to the established offer and its continued presence on the website in both years indicates it remains commercially relevant.
Its disappearance from the website by 2024 strongly suggests weak traction or portfolio rationalisation, so a small firm would likely reallocate resources elsewhere.
As a new 2024 launch in the core facial-cleansing segment, it is still within its testing and build-up phase and should be kept for now.
